title: ServiceConfiguration
description: Configures a gRPC service provider and the associated endpoints, derived from the ServiceConfiguration message of cdds-configuration-service-provider.proto.

endPointNames.description: Note that one service provider can support multiple service endpoints of the same and / or different types.

ServiceProviderAddress.title: ServiceProviderAddress
ServiceProviderAddress.description: Address or DNS name of the gRPC server hosting the CDDS service provider, derived from the ServiceProviderAddress message of cdds-configuration-service-provider.proto. The IP address configuration is only needed for the CDDS service user.

serviceProvider.description: The name of the service provider organization providing the service

terminal.description: Optional: The name of the terminal providing the CDDS service

address.description: The IP address or DNS resolvable name of the gRPC provider. For a provider the address can be omitted.

port.description: The TCP port of the gRPC provider

rootCertificateFile.description: The trust anchor / root certificate use to sign the CDDS user / CDDS provider certificates

certificateFile.description: The certificate file of the CDDS user or the CDDS provider

privateKeyFile.description: The private key file of the CDDS user or the CDDS provider
